annotations.title: Explain a contract or official letter

description: Explains a contract, official letter, tax assessment or terms-and-conditions document in plain language, clause by clause. The document can be sent as plain text, as a base64-encoded PDF, or as base64-encoded photos of its pages — exactly one of the three. Scans and phone photos without a text layer are read by OCR, so a photographed letter works as well as a typed one. Returns every relevant clause with the original wording, a plain language version and why it matters, plus a short summary. It explains what the document says — it does not give legal advice, does not review the document and does not recommend a course of action. Plain text takes 20 to 60 seconds, a scan or photo longer because of OCR. If it is still running when this call returns, use get_explanation with the returned analysis_id.

images.description: Photos or scans of the document pages, base64-encoded, in page order. JPEG, PNG, HEIC or WebP, up to 15 images and 8 MB decoded in total.

language.description: Language the explanation should be written in (ISO 639-1). Defaults to English. The document itself may be in any language.

pdf.description: The document as a base64-encoded PDF, for a file that has no usable text layer or whose layout matters. Up to 8 MB decoded.

text.description: The full text of the document to explain.
